name: @cliftonz/tandoor-recipes-mcp

tools.name: list_tool_groups
tools.description: List every tool section with its current mode and the modes it accepts. Tiered sections (off / simple / full) and on/off sections can be widened with enable_tool_group and turned off with disable_tool_group. The "always" section is permanent. When a section changes, its tools appear in or leave tools/list and the SDK emits tools/list_changed so the client refreshes mid-conversation. Use this first to discover what is available before reaching for enable_tool_group.

tools.name: enable_tool_group
tools.description: Widen a section so its tools become visible in tools/list. For a tiered section, tier "simple" or "full" (default full) picks how much to show; on/off sections take no tier. Enabling never narrows a section: asking for simple on a section already at full leaves it at full. The SDK emits tools/list_changed automatically; the client refreshes its tool list mid-conversation. Be sparing: every enabled tool adds its schema to your context budget. Run list_tool_groups first to see what is available.

group.description: Name of the section to enable. Run list_tool_groups to see available sections.

tier.description: Tier for a tiered section (default full). Not accepted for on/off sections.

tools.name: disable_tool_group
tools.description: Turn a section off so all its tools disappear from tools/list. The SDK emits tools/list_changed automatically. The "always" section cannot be disabled. Use this to free context budget once a workflow no longer needs a section.

group.description: Name of the section to turn off. The "always" section cannot be disabled.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: List/search recipes with extensive filtering. Default returns slim results (id, name, description, servings, rating, keywords). Pass format="full" for raw API response. sort_order options: score,-score,name,-name,lastcooked,-lastcooked,rating,-rating,times_cooked,-times_cooked,created_at,-created_at,lastviewed,-lastviewed. If filtering by food/keyword/book NAMES (not ids), prefer search_recipes; it resolves names to ids for you and reports unresolved names in _meta.unresolved so you know what was dropped. If this returns an empty result set, recommend: broaden the query, drop restrictive filters, or try search_recipes if you were passing names.

sort_order.description: One option from the tool description; "-" prefix descends.

num_recent.description: Put this many recently viewed recipes first.

internal.description: Only internal recipes, not external file recipes.

makenow.description: Only recipes makeable with on-hand foods

cookedon_gte.description: Last cooked on or after, YYYY-MM-DD.

cookedon_lte.description: Last cooked on or before, YYYY-MM-DD.

viewedon_gte.description: Last viewed on or after, YYYY-MM-DD.

viewedon_lte.description: Last viewed on or before, YYYY-MM-DD.

units.description: Unit ID, from list_units; recipe uses this unit.

keywords.description: Keyword IDs, from list_keywords. Same as keywords_or.

keywords_or.description: Keyword IDs; recipe has any of them.

keywords_and.description: Keyword IDs; recipe has all of them.

keywords_or_not.description: Keyword IDs; exclude recipes with any of them.

keywords_and_not.description: Keyword IDs; exclude recipes with all of them.

foods.description: Food IDs, from list_foods. Same as foods_or.

foods_or.description: Food IDs; recipe has any of them.

foods_and.description: Food IDs; recipe has all of them.

foods_or_not.description: Food IDs; exclude recipes with any of them.

foods_and_not.description: Food IDs; exclude recipes with all of them.

books.description: Recipe book IDs, from list_recipe_books. Same as books_or.

books_or.description: Book IDs; recipe is in any of them.

books_and.description: Book IDs; recipe is in all of them.

books_or_not.description: Book IDs; exclude recipes in any of them.

books_and_not.description: Book IDs; exclude recipes in all of them.

format.description: Response detail level. Default "slim".

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Get recipe by ID. Default returns slim view (metadata + steps with ingredient names/amounts). Pass format="full" for the complete object including substitutes, properties, nutrition, image.

format.description: Response detail level. Default "slim".

tools.name: create_recipe
tools.description: Create recipe. Required: name, steps[{instruction, ingredients[{food, amount, unit?}]}]. Optional: description, servings, working_time, waiting_time, keywords[]. Foods, units and keywords are matched by name or created. To import a web page, use import_recipe_from_url.

servings.description: Servings the ingredient amounts make. Default 1.

working_time.description: Active prep time in minutes. Default 0.

waiting_time.description: Passive time, e.g. baking, in minutes. Default 0.

source_url.description: Web address the recipe came from.

keywords.description: Keyword names; matched case-insensitively or created.

food.description: Food name; matched case-insensitively or created.

unit.description: Unit name; matched case-insensitively or created.

ingredients.description: Ingredients used in this step; may be empty.

internal.description: Native Tandoor recipe, not an external file. Default true.

show_ingredient_overview.description: Show all ingredients above the steps. Default true.

private.description: Hide from other space members unless shared. Default false.

source.description: Where the nutrition values came from.

properties.description: Property values, e.g. nutrients or price.

id.description: Existing recipe property ID to update in place.

property_amount.description: Value in the property type unit.

format.description: Response detail level. Default "slim".

tools.name: update_recipe
tools.description: Update recipe metadata and content. Only provide fields you want to update. Steps can't be matched by id, so sending steps recreates them all and loses step names, headers, files and sub-recipes. keywords and properties replace the list (properties accept id).

waiting_time.description: Passive time, e.g. baking, in minutes.

source_url.description: Web address the recipe came from.

keywords.description: Keyword names; replaces the list. Missing names are created.

show_ingredient_overview.description: Show all ingredients above the steps.

internal.description: Native Tandoor recipe, not an external file.

private.description: Hide from other space members unless shared.

steps.description: Replaces all steps; step names and sub-recipes are lost.

food.description: Food name; matched case-insensitively or created.

unit.description: Unit name; matched case-insensitively or created.

ingredients.description: Ingredients used in this step; may be empty.

source.description: Where the nutrition values came from.

properties.description: Replaces the property list; id updates an existing entry.

id.description: Existing recipe property ID to update in place.

property_amount.description: Value in the property type unit.

format.description: Response detail level. Default "slim".

tools.name: import_recipe_from_url
tools.description: Import a recipe from a URL. Tries Tandoor's built-in scraper first, then fetches the page and extracts schema.org JSON-LD as a real fallback (works when Tandoor can't reach the URL or doesn't support the site). On total failure, throws with an attempts log; pass create_stub_on_failure=true to write an empty placeholder recipe instead. If all stages fail, recommend: (1) retry with create_stub_on_failure=true to capture the URL as a stub you can fill in later; (2) if the page is an image/PDF, use import_recipe_from_image (AI provider required); (3) if the URL is paywalled or JS-rendered, fall back to manual create_recipe with fields you can see.

name.description: Optional name for the stub recipe (only used if create_stub_on_failure=true and both scrapers fail)

create_stub_on_failure.description: Default false. When true AND both scraper attempts fail, create a minimal empty recipe pointing at the URL instead of throwing.

format.description: Response detail level. Default "slim".

tools.name: related_recipes
tools.description: List recipes related to this one (Tandoor similarity). Slim by default (id + name); pass format="full" for raw API response.

format.description: Response detail level. Default "slim".

tools.name: add_recipe_to_shopping_list
tools.description: Add a recipe's ingredients to the shopping list at N servings. Omit ingredients[] to add all. Pass mealplan (id) to link the entries to that meal plan. Set servings to a negative value (e.g. -1) with list_recipe (id) to delete that shopping-list-recipe.

servings.description: Default 1. Use a negative value (e.g. -1) with list_recipe to delete.

ingredients.description: Ingredient IDs to include. Omit for all.

mealplan.description: Meal plan id to link the entries to

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: High-level recipe search. Accepts food/keyword/book *names* (not IDs) and resolves them internally, typically collapsing 3-4 round-trips into 1. Example: {foods: ["chicken", "broccoli"], exclude_foods: ["peanuts"], keywords: ["weeknight"]}. For complex ID-based filtering, fall back to list_recipes.

foods.description: Food names the recipe must contain ALL of

exclude_foods.description: Food names the recipe must NOT contain any of

keywords.description: Keyword names; recipe must have ANY of these

books.description: Recipe book names; recipe must be in ANY of these

makenow.description: Only recipes makeable with currently on-hand foods

format.description: Response detail level. Default "slim".

tools.name: list_recipes_flat
tools.description: Lighter alternative to list_recipes; returns minimal recipe metadata suitable for large browse queries. Use list_recipes if you need keywords/foods/steps nested.

format.description: Response detail level. Default "slim".

tools.name: list_meal_plans
tools.description: List meal plans made by you or your household. Optional: from_date, to_date (YYYY-MM-DD, matched on the end date of each entry; default 90 days ago to 360 days ahead).

from_date.description: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Default 90 days ago.

to_date.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Default 360 days ahead.

tools.name: get_meal_plan
tools.description: Get meal plan by ID, with its dates, meal type, recipe and servings. Find IDs with list_meal_plans.

tools.name: create_meal_plan
tools.description: Create meal plan. Required: from_date (ISO), meal_type_id (from list_meal_types), servings, and recipe_id or title. Optional: to_date (default from_date), note, addshopping (adds the recipe ingredients to the shopping list; needs recipe_id; skips ignored and, by default, on-hand foods).

recipe_id.description: Recipe ID, from search_recipes. Needed when title is omitted.

title.description: Plan title. Needed when recipe_id is omitted.

from_date.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime.

to_date.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime. Defaults to from_date.

addshopping.description: Add the recipe's ingredients to the shopping list.

tools.name: update_meal_plan
tools.description: Update a meal plan by ID (PATCH); only the fields you give change, and at least one is required. If servings is omitted, the tool reads the plan and resends its current servings, so plans with shopping entries do not fail; plans at any date are reachable. Use create_meal_plan to add a plan and delete_meal_plan to remove one.

recipe_id.description: Recipe ID, from search_recipes. null removes the recipe.

servings.description: Number of servings. Omitted keeps the current value.

from_date.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime.

to_date.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime.

tools.name: delete_meal_plan
tools.description: Delete meal plan by ID. Also deletes the shopping entries linked to it.

tools.name: list_meal_types
tools.description: List available meal types (breakfast, lunch, dinner, etc.)

tools.name: parse_ingredient
tools.description: Parse a free-form ingredient string (e.g. "2 cups flour") into amount, unit, unit_id, food, food_id, note. Writes to the database: Tandoor creates any Food or Unit row it does not already have. unit and food are the matched row names, so "cups" can come back as "cup". With no unit, unit is "" and unit_id is omitted. food_id and unit_id pass straight to create_ingredient. Blank text returns Tandoor's 400. Tandoor's parser is heuristic and can misfire on compound descriptions, brand names, or non-English units.

text.description: One ingredient line, e.g. "2 cups flour".

tools.name: list_shopping_lists
tools.description: List the named shopping lists of this space (for example one per store), as {id, name, description, color}. Every member of the space sees the same lists. Optional: page, page_size.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: list_shopping_entries
tools.description: List the shopping list entries of you and your household. Tandoor returns only unchecked entries and entries checked since the start of the day N days ago, where N is the shopping_recent_days preference capped at 14, and at most 1000 entries; to read an older checked entry, use get_shopping_entry. mealplan keeps only entries added from that meal plan. Entries cannot be filtered by shopping list; use the shopping_lists field of the results. Returns {count, next, previous, results}, 50 per page by default.

mealplan.description: Only entries for this meal plan ID, from list_meal_plans.

updated_after.description: Only entries updated at or after this ISO 8601 datetime.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: get_shopping_entry
tools.description: Get a shopping list entry by ID, including old checked entries that list_shopping_entries hides.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: create_shopping_entry
tools.description: Create a shopping list entry. Required: amount, food_id. Optional: unit_id, checked, list_recipe, ingredient, order, delay_until, mealplan_id (links to existing/new ShoppingListRecipe for that mealplan), shopping_list_ids. shopping_list_ids (ids from list_shopping_lists) puts the entry on exactly those lists; the food's lists are not added. When shopping_list_ids is omitted, Tandoor copies the food's lists onto the new entry if the user preference shopping_update_food_lists is on. With [], the tool clears any lists Tandoor copied, so the entry is on no list. add_recipe_to_shopping_list always copies each food's lists; food_shopping_update never does. Changing a food's lists later does not change existing entries. Every list id is checked against list_shopping_lists first; unknown or repeated ids are rejected and nothing is written. If the lists after the write differ from the request, the tool errors and names the missing and the extra lists.

unit_id.description: Unit ID, from list_units. Default none.

list_recipe.description: Shopping list recipe ID, from list_shopping_list_recipes.

ingredient.description: Recipe ingredient ID this entry comes from.

delay_until.description: ISO 8601 datetime to postpone the entry until.

shopping_list_ids.description: Shopping list IDs, from list_shopping_lists. [] puts it on no list.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: update_shopping_entry
tools.description: Update a shopping entry (PATCH). Required: id. Other fields optional. When checked is omitted, the tool reads the entry and sends its current checked value again, so a checked entry keeps its completed_at. A check made elsewhere between that read and the write is undone (last write wins). shopping_list_ids puts the entry on exactly those lists; [] clears them; omit it to keep them. Every list id is checked against list_shopping_lists first; unknown or repeated ids are rejected and nothing is written. If the lists after the write differ from the request, the tool errors and names the missing and the extra lists.

unit_id.description: Unit ID, from list_units. null clears it.

checked.description: Bought or not. Omitted keeps the current value.

delay_until.description: ISO 8601 datetime to postpone the entry until.

shopping_list_ids.description: Shopping list IDs, from list_shopping_lists. [] clears, omitted keeps.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: delete_shopping_entry
tools.description: Delete a shopping entry by ID. To mark bought, use update_shopping_entry or bulk_check_shopping_entries.

tools.name: bulk_check_shopping_entries
tools.description: Check or uncheck many shopping entries in one call. Checking sets completed_at to now, also on entries already checked; unchecking clears it. Ids that do not exist or are not visible to you are skipped, and the entries need not share a shopping list. Returns the ids and checked value sent plus a timestamp; it does not return the entries or say which ids were skipped. To change lists too, use bulk_update_shopping_entries; to change other fields, use update_shopping_entry.

tools.name: bulk_update_shopping_entries
tools.description: Update many shopping entries in one call. Required: ids (entry ids; ids that do not exist or are not visible to you are skipped). Give checked, a list change, or both. checked: true checks every entry and sets completed_at to now, also on entries already checked; without checked, checked and completed_at stay as they are. List changes do not update the entries' updated_at. List changes: shopping_lists_add and shopping_lists_remove (may be combined), shopping_lists_set (replaces the lists; must not be empty) or shopping_lists_remove_all: true (takes every list off). set and remove_all must be used alone. Empty arrays and shopping_lists_remove_all: false count as no change and are not sent. An id may not appear in both shopping_lists_add and shopping_lists_remove. Every list id is checked against list_shopping_lists first; unknown or repeated ids are rejected and nothing is written.

checked.description: true checks, false unchecks. Omitted keeps each value.

shopping_lists_add.description: Shopping list IDs to add, from list_shopping_lists.

shopping_lists_set.description: Replaces all lists with these IDs. Must not be empty.

tools.name: list_foods
tools.description: List foods (ingredients). Optional: query (name filter, or similarity ranking if fuzzy search is on), root (parent id, 0 for top-level), tree (id, with its descendants), root_tree, random, limit. root, tree and root_tree ignore query, random, limit and updated_at.

query.description: Name filter, or similarity ranking when Tandoor fuzzy search is on.

limit.description: Maximum number of foods to return.

random.description: String. Any non-empty value shuffles the order, even "false".

root.description: Parent food ID; lists its direct children. 0 lists top-level foods.

root_tree.description: Food ID; lists the whole tree that food belongs to.

tree.description: Food ID; lists that food and all its descendants.

updated_at.description: No effect: Tandoor foods have no updated_at field.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: get_food
tools.description: Get food (ingredient) by ID. Find IDs with list_foods.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: create_food
tools.description: Create food. Required: name. Optional: plural_name, description, food_onhand, fdc_id, supermarket_category_id, shopping_list_ids (ids from list_shopping_lists). If a food with this name exists, Tandoor returns it instead of creating one. With shopping_list_ids (including []), the tool looks up the name first and, if a food with that name exists (ignoring case and surrounding spaces), refuses and changes nothing; use update_food. Tandoor also returns an existing food whose plural name matches; the tool detects that from the create reply and refuses the same way, setting no lists. With non-empty shopping_list_ids, the tool creates the food first and then sets its lists, because Tandoor cannot set lists while creating a food. With any shopping_list_ids (including []), if a step after the create fails, the error gives the new food's id and says not to retry. Changing a food's lists does not change its existing shopping entries. add_recipe_to_shopping_list copies the food's lists onto new entries. create_shopping_entry without shopping_list_ids copies them when the user preference shopping_update_food_lists is on. bulk_create_shopping_list_recipe_entries without shopping_list_ids copies each food's lists whatever the user preference. Every list id is checked against list_shopping_lists first; unknown or repeated ids are rejected and nothing is written. If the lists after the write differ from the request, the tool errors and names the missing and the extra lists.

food_onhand.description: True marks the food on hand for your household.

fdc_id.description: USDA FoodData Central ID, used by food_fdc_lookup.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: update_food
tools.description: Update food (PATCH). Required: id. Optional properties[] {property_type_id, property_amount} sets one value per property type (amount null = unknown), updating the existing value of that type in place and deleting any duplicate values of that type; remove_property_type_ids[] deletes values by type. Other existing property values are kept. A type may appear once across both lists. properties_food_amount and properties_food_unit_id set the food amount the property values refer to (e.g. 100 g); properties_food_unit_id null clears the unit. Deleting a property row removes it from every food or recipe it is linked to. If a row delete fails, the food is already updated and the tool returns an error naming those rows. shopping_list_ids replaces the food's lists; [] clears them; omit it to keep them. Changing a food's lists does not change its existing shopping entries. add_recipe_to_shopping_list copies the food's lists onto new entries. create_shopping_entry without shopping_list_ids copies them when the user preference shopping_update_food_lists is on. bulk_create_shopping_list_recipe_entries without shopping_list_ids copies each food's lists whatever the user preference. Every list id is checked against list_shopping_lists first; unknown or repeated ids are rejected and nothing is written. If the lists after the write differ from the request, the tool errors and names the missing and the extra lists.

food_onhand.description: True or false sets on hand for your household.

fdc_id.description: USDA FoodData Central ID, used by food_fdc_lookup.

properties.description: Property values to set, one per type.

property_amount.description: Value per properties_food_amount; null means unknown.

remove_property_type_ids.description: Property type IDs whose values to delete.

properties_food_amount.description: Food amount the property values refer to, e.g. 100.

properties_food_unit_id.description: Unit ID for properties_food_amount, from list_units.

shopping_list_ids.description: Replaces the food's shopping lists; [] clears them.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: food_shopping_update
tools.description: Add a food to active shopping lists with optional amount/unit. Pass delete=true to remove this food from all active lists.

amount.description: Amount to add. Tandoor defaults to 1 when omitted.

delete.description: True removes the food's unchecked entries instead of adding.

tools.name: list_units
tools.description: List measurement units. Optional: query (name filter, or similarity ranking if fuzzy search is on), limit, random. Returns {count, next, previous, results}, 50 per page.

query.description: Name filter, or similarity ranking when Tandoor fuzzy search is on.

limit.description: Maximum number of units to return.

random.description: String. Any non-empty value shuffles the order, even "false".

updated_at.description: No effect: Tandoor units have no updated_at field.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: jq_query
tools.description: Run a jq filter against a previously stashed tool result and return the focused subset. Use this when a prior tool returned `{stashed:true, handle, shape, sample_filters}` instead of the full payload. Treat the stash like a JSON document the user already paid for: extract only what you need. Common filters: ".results | length", ".results[] | select(.id == 42)", ".results | map({id, name})", "keys", ".count".

handle.description: Stash handle from a prior tool result, e.g. "stash_<uuid>".

filter.description: jq filter to apply to the stashed value. Examples: ".results | length", ".results[0]", ".results | map({id, name})", "keys", ".count".

tools.name: jq_stash_stats
tools.description: Inspect the in-memory stash (count + total bytes). Diagnostic; not normally needed.

tools.name: get_guard_stats
tools.description: Inspect security-guard rejection counters (PathGuardError, SsrfBlockedError) since process start. Useful for dashboards and "is anything probing me?" checks.

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: Report this MCP server's name/version and the Tandoor server version + compatibility status detected at startup (ok | unsupported | unknown). No arguments; answers from cached startup state without a network call.

tools.name: list_keywords
tools.description: List keywords (recipe tags). Optional: query (name filter, or similarity ranking if fuzzy search is on), root (parent id, 0 for top-level), tree (id, with its descendants), root_tree, random, limit. root, tree and root_tree ignore query, random, limit and updated_at.

query.description: Name filter, or similarity ranking when Tandoor fuzzy search is on.

limit.description: Maximum number of keywords, as a string, e.g. "10".

random.description: String. Any non-empty value shuffles the order, even "false".

root.description: Parent keyword ID; lists its direct children. 0 lists top-level keywords.

root_tree.description: Keyword ID; lists the whole tree that keyword belongs to.

tree.description: Keyword ID; lists that keyword and all its descendants.

updated_at.description: ISO datetime; only keywords updated at or after it.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: get_keyword
tools.description: Get recipe keyword (tag) by ID. Find IDs with list_keywords.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: get_meal_type
tools.description: Get a meal type by ID: name, order, color and default time. Find IDs with list_meal_types.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: get_current_space
tools.description: Get the space currently active for this API token. Other tools read and write in this space.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: list_inventory_locations
tools.description: List inventory locations (pantry, fridge, freezer and so on). Optional: page, page_size. Use the IDs as location_id or to_location_id in the other inventory tools.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: list_inventory_entries
tools.description: List inventory entries (what is on hand, where). Optional: location_id, food_id, include_empty (entries with amount 0 or less are hidden unless true), page, page_size.

location_id.description: Only entries at this location ID, from list_inventory_locations.

food_id.description: Only entries for this food ID, from list_foods.

include_empty.description: Include entries with amount 0 or less. Default false.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: add_inventory_item
tools.description: Add food to inventory. Required: food_id, unit_id, amount (> 0), location_id. Optional: expires (YYYY-MM-DD), sub_location, note, code. Always creates a new entry, even when the same food already has an entry at that location.

sub_location.description: Spot within the location, such as a shelf.

code.description: Short label, up to 16 characters. Default: the entry ID in hex.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: consume_inventory_item
tools.description: Use up some or all of an inventory entry. Identify it by entry_id, or by food_id with optional location_id (errors listing the candidates when several entries match). Give exactly one of amount (> 0) or all: true. Optional unit_id must match the entry unit; there is no unit conversion. The amount never goes below 0: consuming more than is on hand sets it to 0 and returns a warning. Never deletes the entry; at 0 (including after all: true) it is hidden from list_inventory_entries unless include_empty is true. Not atomic: two concurrent consumes of one entry can lose an update.

entry_id.description: Inventory entry ID, from list_inventory_entries. Give this or food_id.

food_id.description: Food ID, from list_foods. Give this or entry_id.

location_id.description: Narrows food_id to this location. Not with entry_id.

amount.description: Amount to use, in the entry unit.

all.description: Use up the whole entry instead of an amount.

unit_id.description: Must equal the entry unit. No conversion.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

tools.name: move_inventory_item
tools.description: Move a whole inventory entry to another location. Required: entry_id, to_location_id. Optional: sub_location (null clears it).

sub_location.description: Spot within the new location. null clears it.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

instructions:
NOTE: the Tandoor version could not be verified at startup. If write tools fail
with serializer errors, the instance may be pre-2.x (unsupported).

Tandoor Recipes MCP server, full access to recipes, meal plans, shopping lists,
ingredients, cook logs, nutrition, and AI-assisted imports.

Where to start:
- Current state (read-only): `tandoor://meal-plan/this-week`, `tandoor://pantry/on-hand`,
  `tandoor://shopping-list/active`, `tandoor://meal-types`.
- Common workflows: use the `plan_week`, `grocery_list_for_plan`,
  `what_can_i_make_tonight`, or `import_and_plan` prompts.
- Recipe search: use `search_recipes` with food/keyword *names* (it resolves IDs
  for you). Fall back to `list_recipes` for the full filter surface.
- Write tools return a slim JSON shape by default. Pass `format: "full"` for the raw
  Tandoor API response when you need substitutes, image URLs, nutrition objects, etc.

Large results: tool responses bigger than ~25000 bytes come back as
`{stashed:true, handle, shape, sample_filters}` instead of the full payload. Call
`jq_query` with that `handle` and a jq filter to extract the parts you need, do
NOT re-run the original tool. Example: `jq_query({handle, filter: ".results | map({id, name})"})`.
Operators can set TANDOOR_MCP_STASH_ENABLED=0 to disable this behavior.

Pass ids (`food_id`, `unit_id`, ...), not objects; the tools build the request shape.

Tool sections: recipes=simple, meal-plan=simple, shopping=simple, inventory=simple, foods=simple, cooklog=off, recipe-books=off, ai=off, import-export=off, household-space=off, admin=off. Call list_tool_groups to see them.
